executive_summary: The infrastructure is currently in a low-risk state with underutilized resources and no immediate end-of-support risks. However, the single server setup introduces potential failure points that should be addressed to improve reliability.

predicted_failures.description: The single server setup lacks redundancy, increasing the risk of service disruption in case of hardware failure or maintenance.

root_causes.description: The infrastructure relies on a single server for all critical services, lacking redundancy and high availability.

preventive_measures.action: Implement active-active high availability setup for critical services.
preventive_measures.rationale: This measure will ensure that there is no single point of failure and service continuity can be maintained during maintenance or failures.
